_about: Measurements quoted by the 'why' picture (P7) that the clean-run matrix does not itself produce. Each entry says what was measured, when, and where to find the raw data. Only entries marked status=measured may be drawn as causes.

gzip_wikidata.claim: Asking Wikidata for gzip cuts the claims response about 6.5x and the call about 23%
gzip_wikidata.method: the same Wikidata claims request for the ten companies in perf_tests/companies.py, two rounds, plain against gzip, alternating, from the development Mac

v3_old_image_timeouts.claim: The V3 image built before the Wikipedia v2 backend cut-over timed out on Wikipedia and merged lookups; the current production image does not
v3_old_image_timeouts.method: the same perf_tests/baseline.py matrix on cafe-1 at 500m CPU and 1Gi against each V3 image; 30 s timeout on the old image, 120 s on the current one
v3_old_image_timeouts.cause: V3 commit f65595b (2026-09-27 06:15) replaced the wptools request layer with direct narrowed requests
